query:
SELECT 
  'Sales' as type,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(totalSaleValue) as total_revenue,
  SUM(profit) as total_profit,
  MIN(createdAt) as first_date,
  MAX(createdAt) as last_date
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Inventory' as type,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(price * quantity) as total_value,
  0 as total_profit,
  MIN(createdAt) as first_date,
  MAX(createdAt) as last_date
FROM inventory
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m') = '2026-06';
